name: ASM-018 mini drone motor arm assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a small quadcopter motor-arm module with repeated arms, motors, propellers, landing legs, and fasteners.

tasks.prompt: Create a mini quadcopter drone motor arm assembly with a central electronics hub, four cross arms, four brushless motor pods, crossed propeller blades, landing legs, and visible repeated fasteners. Keep the silhouette readable as a compact drone using robust primitive solids.
assumptions: Intermediate assembly benchmark expands readable mechatronics/product coverage with a recognizable quadcopter layout.
Repeated components are functional drone parts: four arms, four motors, propeller blades, four landing legs, and repeated screws.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
